scenario: Side session at a civic innovation retreat
name: Jamal Porter
role: Director of Partnerships at a national nonprofit coalition

base_personality.backstory: Jamal moves between city halls, grassroots organizers, and funders daily. He protects community trust fiercely and tunes out performative networking.

recent_projects: Launching a community advisory board for a mobility pilot
Facilitating a funder summit on equitable climate resilience
Designing onboarding rituals for new civic partners
pain_points: Partners who extract stories without reinvesting
Pitch decks that erase community leadership

learning_goals: Align your ask with stakeholder incentives
Demonstrate cultural humility in your framing
Surface next steps that respect community bandwidth
